changelog: AFTER EVERY BATTLE, A REPORT: turns taken, enemies defeated, who was kept and who was lost, every soldier's rank, damage and kills, and your spoils — salvage and the drafts waiting, including a Village draft for each village you razed. BUILDINGS REWORKED: every card that raises a building, and every card that conjures cards, is One-Shot until you upgrade it. The Engineer reclaims about half his Builds back to the discard, and gains two new Doctrines: Prefab Yards (a free Build each turn) and Live Grid (build beside any of your units). The Warlord brings a Barracks into every battle, and the Nomad a Walking Base — raise a building on it and the building walks. Mentor, Field Promotion and Total War are One-Shot. Doctrine cards can now be drafted, bought and won (they never could before). FIXES AND TUNING: a building your commander brings is placed with your army, beside your HQ (one could appear across the map); a kept card stays kept when All In redraws your hand; Provoke now drags its target a step toward your nearest unit (two when upgraded); the Heavy Tank moves 2.
